pages.text: Every tier offers the same two routes (see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l)): bank the $(bold)token threshold$(), or clear the $(bold)boss-rush share$(). This entry lists the targets tier by tier.$(br2)You only need to hit $(bold)one$() of the two. Check your standing any time with $(bold)/icraft codex balance$().

pages.title: Tier 1 → Tier 2
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Tokens:$() bank $(t2)500$().$(li)$(bold)Boss Rush:$() clear $(t2)80%$() of the Tier 1 bosses (the Overworld roster).$(br2)Earn however you like — build Create machines, cultivate Botania mana, loot structures, or hunt Overworld bosses. Every lane feeds the same pool.

pages.title: Tier 2 → Tier 3
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Tokens:$() bank $(t3)1000$().$(li)$(bold)Boss Rush:$() clear $(t3)90%$() of the Tier 2 bosses — the Twilight Forest, Aether, and Blue Skies rosters.$(br2)Thermal machines, Ars Nouveau reagents, dimension loot, or dimensional bosses all count toward it.

pages.title: Tier 3 → Tier 4
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Tokens:$() bank $(t4)2000$().$(li)$(bold)Boss Rush:$() clear $(t4)100%$() of the Tier 3 bosses — Nether, Undergarden, Deeper Dark, and the Abyss — finishing with $(bold)Lucifer$().$(br2)$(warn)The combat pinch:$() the boss-rush route to T4 ends at Lucifer, the combat capstone. A combat-averse player simply banks 2000 tokens instead and never has to fight him.

pages.title: Tier 4 — the finale
pages.text: Tier 4 has $(bold)no token gate$() — it is the top of the ladder.$(br2)The post-game (the Ad Astra planets) opens when you defeat the $(t4)Ender Dragon$(). Reaching the End first requires the Deep-Aether $(bold)End Compass$() — see $(l:icraft:progression/dimensions)Dimensional Progression$(/l).
